articles.title: Ravens to be without Lamar for 3rd game in row
articles.summary: The Ravens will be without quarterback Lamar Jackson for the third straight game as he continues to deal with a hamstring injury. Tyler Huntley will get the start for Sunday's home game against the Bears.

articles.title: QB Taylor (knee) ruled out; Fields to start for Jets
articles.summary: Jets quarterback Tyrod Taylor has been ruled out against the Bengals with a knee injury, meaning Justin Fields will remain the starter.

articles.title: Commanders' McLaurin, Samuel to play vs. Chiefs
articles.summary: The Commanders will finally have both of their top two receivers available as Terry McLaurin and Deebo Samuel will play against the Chiefs.

articles.title: Sources: Falcons highly likely to start Cousins
articles.summary: Kirk Cousins is "highly likely" to be the Falcons' starting quarterback against the Dolphins, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter, as Michael Penix Jr. deals with a bone bruise in his left knee.

articles.title: Sources: Bengals' Hendrickson expected to play
articles.summary: Bengals defensive end Trey Hendrickson is expected to play against the Jets, sources told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.

articles.title: Giants, Daboll, Skattebo all fined over Dart exam
articles.summary: The Giants were assessed a $200,000 fine for violating the concussion protocol around an exam of quarterback Jaxon Dart, while coach Brian Daboll was fined $100,000 and RB Cam Skattebo $15,000 for conduct detrimental to the league.

articles.title: Eagles without WR Brown (hamstring) vs. Giants
articles.summary: Eagles wide receiver A.J. Brown will not play against the Giants after being sidelined all week with a hamstring injury.

articles.title: 49ers' Purdy, Pearsall to remain out vs. Texans
articles.summary: With starter Brock Purdy slowly working his way back from the right big toe injury that's kept him out since Week 4, the 49ers will again turn to backup Mac Jones on Sunday against the Texans. Ricky Pearsall also is out.
